in_hebrew.name: Mendie
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Mendie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'mendos', meaning 'healer' or 'soother'. In the New Testament, the name Mendie is not directly used. However, it is akin to the name Minerva in Latin mythology, associated with healing and wisdom.
